description: This file defines the 'DB' class in the OpenCart system, acting as a database adaptor wrapper that initializes a specific database engine adaptor and provides methods for executing queries, escaping values, and checking connection status.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: A database adaptor class that initializes a specific database engine adaptor and provides methods for database operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection with provided options, loading the specified database engine adaptor.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query using the adaptor.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string value to protect against SQL injection.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID after an insert operation.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is active.
